## Questions for the instructor

<!-- Optional. Anything you are unsure about, or want feedback on before you start. -->
We would appreciate guidance on three questions before finalizing our scope:
1. Data: Is our own recorded lecture transcript an acceptable data source, and would several lecture transcript provide enough material for a credible evaluation?
2. Evaluation: We plan to use human annotations, but deciding what content to remove involves subjective judgments. How should we establish reliable ground truth and demonstrate that the agent’s improvement loop produces meaningful gains over a fixed-prompt baseline?
3. Scope and deployment: Does a fully local, personalized transcript-cleaning agent meet the course expectations, or would a remotely deployed agent serving an enterprise use case be a better fit?
